_README: Hand-transcribed free-provision STOCK, in each entry declared unit (legacy entries are thousand TL). An override wins outright (source_page=-1). Zero means an explicitly disclosed nil stock or full cancellation; inability to parse is NEVER evidence of zero. Null preserves a disclosed but unknown amount. Current stocks come from their own dated auditor qualification or liability note; historical-opinion paragraphs, provision flows and deferred-tax assets are not stocks. source_sha256 records exact source bytes for source-verified 2026-08-31 repairs.
